verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own cardholder-credential capabilities. An in-app PIN change flow is offered through its iOS SDK. Cards can be enrolled in 3D Secure through one-time password or out-of-band authentication, the latter via the Authentication SDK routing challenges to the cardholder's device. Card detail reveal is also documented. However, the evidence shows only PIN 'change', not initial PIN set or a forgotten-PIN reset flow. It also does not show that 3DS enrollment is done through an explicit API call rather than other configuration. missing for 10: documented PIN set/reset (not just change) flows, explicit API endpoints for 3DS enrollment, region-specific 3DS requirement handling, non-iOS PIN coverage, independent hands-on corroboration.
